title: Understanding PCA Components
text: PCA involves transforming the data into a new coordinate system. The transformation is defined by the matrices U, S, and V. The matrix V contains the principal components.

title: Using the V Matrix
text: The matrix V contains the principal components. To find the coordinates of a new data point in the PCA space, you need to multiply the data point by the V matrix.

title: Data Point for Contestant D
text: Contestant D has the data point (3, $$\frac{8}{3}$$, 8/3). Use this data point to find the PCA coordinates by multiplying it with the V matrix.
